scene: dusk aangan: mother cooking on chulha, father returning on bicycle
slogan: Maa-Papa ki dua saath chalti hai, toh raaste khud aasaan ho jaate hain.

scene: winter sunrise potters lane: potter at chaak, drying matkas, brick kiln, women carrying matkas to well
slogan: Chaak pe ghoomti mitti bhi, MEHNAT se hi bartan banti hai.

scene: winter afternoon village rooftops: kids flying a kite with charkhi, dadi on charpai with peanuts and gur, kites in sky, mustard fields beyond
slogan: Chhat ki patangein aaj bhi dil ko UDAAN sikhati hain.

scene: misty winter sunrise river ghat: boatman poling a wooden boat with two villagers, stone steps with brass lotas, banyan tree, egrets, cows and mustard fields on far bank, mud houses with chulha smoke
slogan: Lehron se na lado, saath BEHNA seekho, kinara mil jayega.

scene: late-winter golden afternoon dirt road through mustard fields: two school boys sharing one bicycle with a pinwheel, mud hut with tube-well, neem tree, parrots, distant village with chulha smoke
slogan: Sachchi DOSTI mein kachche raaste bhi ghar se lagte hain.

scene: late-autumn harvest sunset: family sharing rotis on a charpai under a neem tree, haystacks, bullock cart with two white bullocks, thatched mud house with chulha smoke, birds flying home
slogan: Thaali mein roti, apno ka saath, yahi asli DHAN hai.

scene: post-monsoon golden late afternoon: lone tall taad (palmyra) palm on a field bund in shining paddy fields, school girl with umbrella walking head held high, buffalo in pond, tiled mud houses with hand pump and chulha smoke, faint rainbow
slogan: Taad ka ped akela sahi, par sar UTHAKE khada rehta hai.

scene: misty early-winter sunrise: three schoolkids with slates and cloth bags walking a winding pagdandi through young wheat fields to a whitewashed village school under a neem tree, farmer ploughing with two white bullocks and egrets, mud houses with chulha smoke
slogan: Pagdandi bhi chalte chalte hi RAASTA banti hai.

scene: misty winter night aangan: joint family (dadi on charpai, parents in shawls, two kids, puppy) warming hands around an alaav bonfire, whitewashed mud houses with hurricane lantern, buffalo under thatched shed, fog over fields, starry sky with crescent moon
slogan: Thandi raaton mein apno ka saath hi sabse garam ALAAV hai.
